meta.note: First-principles redesign for prassanna.io, revised to a work log: mono for structure and things made, serif for reading.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. A cool, slightly grey paper, never cream.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code blocks, the margin column on narrow screens, hover fill on list rows.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The rare lifted surface: the command palette and menus. Not for cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and verse on paper, paper-sunk, paper-raised, indigo-soft and marigold-soft (all ≥10:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Log dates and kinds, table secondary columns, margin metadata, leads and summaries on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised (≥5.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate without meaning: between list rows, under the nav. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: button outlines, input borders, the verse spine (≥3.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: The one accent. Links, the primary button, focus ring, tag text. Reads ≥6.6:1 on paper, paper-sunk, paper-raised and indigo-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: indigo-soft
tokens.usage: Tag and series chip fill, with indigo or ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: Text on a solid indigo fill (primary button). 9.2:1 light, 8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The signature mark, used sparingly: the 'recent' dot (activity in the last 30 days), the highlighter stroke, cover blocks. Never as text on paper (2.1:1 in light).

tokens.name: marigold-soft
tokens.usage: Highlighter fill behind ink: marked passages, the active nav item, text selection.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text on a solid marigold fill. 7.4:1 light, 9.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥6.6:1 on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The site's name in the nav and footer. Always lowercase, as the domain is written.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heads on index pages and the home page: one lowercase word (log, projects, writing).

styles.name: item
styles.usage: Names of things made: projects, repos, releases, in the log and the projects table.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table cells that hold data: language, dates, years.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Log dates and kinds, margin metadata, table headers. Sentence case or lowercase, never all caps.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code (inline at 0.85em of the surrounding serif).

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: I build infrastructure for AI agents.
styles.usage: The home page's opening sentence. One per site.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Essay, poem and episode titles on their own page.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Why long-running agents lose the plot

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: h3 inside an essay; post titles in the writing index.

styles.name: entry
styles.usage: Titles of written things in the log (essays, poems, episodes), beside mono names of built things.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: How autonomous agents lose the plot.
styles.usage: Essay subtitle under the title. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Running for a long time, with minimal oversight, is itself the corrupting force.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Let your coding agents talk to each other.

styles.name: verse
styles.sample: You're asleep in the warm ocean,
styles.usage: Poetry lines. Extra leading so each line breathes; never justified.

spacing.note: 4px base. Vertical rhythm in prose follows the body line (31px ≈ space-8).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, tag inner vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding, gap between meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Log and table row padding (top and bottom); button horizontal padding; gap between nav items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap between title and lead.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between margin column and text column; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Paragraph-group spacing; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Before an essay h2; between list sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Header to first content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between major page regions; above the footer.

radius.note: Nearly square. Rounding is a hint of softness, never a pill-button aesthetic.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, highlighter marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Command palette, menus. Nothing else.

layout.note: Two widths: page-max for reading, wide-max for data. The margin column holds facts beside essays; the log gives every item its date and kind in fixed columns.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the text column (prose, verse, lists).

tokens.name: margin-col
tokens.usage: Width of the left margin column for dates, series, repo facts. Collapses above the text under 760px.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: The reading frame for essays and verse: margin-col + gap + measure.

tokens.name: wide-max
tokens.usage: Width of the log, the projects table and the nav: data needs more room than prose.
